name: Hinott's Assistance
summary: In Orgrimmar, poisoned rogues seek Hinott's Assistance before Zanzil's mixture claims their lives. The toxin came from an infiltration in the Barrens, and Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill can offer a cure and teach the brewing of poisons.

sections.title: A Toxic Predicament
sections.body: A daring infiltration of the Venture Company's tower north of the Sludge Fen leaves rogues poisoned by Zanzil's altered mixture. It dulls their reflexes and threatens their lives. Shenthul, the rogue trainer in Orgrimmar, knows local remedies cannot help. He sends the poisoned rogue across the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms for care.

sections.title: Journey to Tarren Mill
sections.body: The search for a cure leads south through Lordaeron to Tarren Mill, a village in Hillsbrad Foothills. Serge Hinott lives there as an apothecary, known for his fascination with virulent brews. Ordinary healers recoil from Zanzil's venom, but Hinott treats the deadly compound with professional glee. He can dissect the foul concoction and teach worthy rogues to brew their own venoms.

faq.q: Why do I need to see Serge Hinott?
faq.answer: Serge Hinott is an apothecary in Tarren Mill who specializes in rare toxins and their antidotes. Ordinary healers cannot purge Zanzil's altered mixture, so Hinott is the contact who can analyze it, save your life, and teach you poisoncraft.

aliases: how to get to tarren mill
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is a Forsaken settlement in northern Hillsbrad Foothills. From Orgrimmar, take the zeppelin to the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades, travel south through Silverpine Forest, then turn east along the road into Hillsbrad.

faq.q: How did I get poisoned in the first place?
aliases: how did i get zanzil poison
faq.answer: You were infected during the covert task called Mission: Possible But Not Probable at the Venture Company tower north of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. Opening the high-security chest exposed you to Zanzil's altered mixture, leaving you with a lingering, debilitating affliction.

faq.q: What happens after Serge Hinott receives the sample?
faq.answer: After Serge Hinott receives the sample, he examines its properties and prepares an antidote to cleanse your system. Once he cures the toxin, he shares his expertise so rogues can learn to brew and apply their own poisons.

faq.q: Who is Shenthul and why did he send me away?
faq.answer: Shenthul is the rogue trainer of the Shattered Hand in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He oversaw your test of skill in the Barrens and saw that Zanzil's concoction was beyond Orgrimmar's medical knowledge, so he sent you to a Hillsbrad specialist.

faq.q: Can any other class complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. This training is part of the rogue lineage and teaches the fundamentals of brewing poisons and remedies.

angles.text: As a rogue, you face a rite of passage that tests your stamina and opens the door to crafting your own venoms.
As a Horde member, you see practical cooperation between Kalimdor's orc and troll rogues and the Forsaken's alchemical knowledge in Lordaeron.
